# ImageFitMode

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

How to fit an image within its bounds

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Contain`: Scale to fit within bounds, maintain aspect ratio
- `Cover`: Scale to fill bounds, maintain aspect ratio, crop if needed
- `Fill`: Stretch to fill bounds, ignore aspect ratio
- `FitHeight`: Scale to fit height, maintain aspect ratio
- `ActualSize`: Use actual image size (1 pixel = 1 point)
